bridgeDownloadBaseUrl.description: Legacy public base URL for media-download fallback. Usually leave empty in single-port mode.

redactWxidsInLogs.description: Mask wxid_* identifiers in WeChat plugin logs

redactExtraWxids.description: Additional exact-match WeChat ids to redact, for example custom ids like xdoufux
